prompt: Create an original 180 second Japanese acoustic instrumental instrumental composition for mystery, nocturnal exploration and restrained suspense. Mood: mysterious, tense, nocturnal. Instruments: koto, shakuhachi, soft hand drum. Style: sparse plucked phrases and gentle breathy flute, no voice. Tempo approximately 58 BPM; G minor. Main idea: an ascending fourth answered by a stepwise descent. Use unresolved suspended harmony, careful space and subtle low-register movement; no jump scares. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-01:00] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [01:00-02:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [02:00-03:00] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 03:00.

description.en: A melancholic and reflective instrumental piece featuring a prominent flute melody over a string section and a subtle plucked string accompaniment. The piece builds in intensity and instrumentation, incorporating piano-like harmonies and a fuller orchestral sound before a gentle fade-out.
description.zh: 一首忧郁而沉思的器乐曲，以悠扬的长笛旋律为主，配以弦乐和微妙的拨弦乐器伴奏。乐曲逐渐增强，融入了钢琴般的和声和更丰富的管弦乐音效，最后温柔地渐弱。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
